summary: Cross-references an external earnings calendar against TradFi perpetual contracts and Ondo tokenized equities. The earnings calendar arrives as JSON input (per macro_layer.md WebSearch contract) — the case never WebSearches itself.
core_logic: Match each earnings entry against TradFi perpetuals universe (51 contracts).
Match each entry against Ondo tokenized-equity universe (264 tokens).
Compute attention score: EPS surprise potential, days_to_report, sector alpha.
Rank top-N by composite score; flag whether tradable on both venues.
recommended_next_step: Drop top-N tickers into structured-trade-plan or three-tier-strategy for entry zones.
